pages.text: Craft this primer with $(item)Leather$() and three $(item)Empty Pages$(). If Patchouli is installed, right-clicking it opens this manual. Without Patchouli, the item still exists so packs and servers can still hand it out cleanly.

Mystcraft revolves around five things: $(item)Empty Pages$(), $(item)Symbol Pages$(), $(item)Descriptive Books$(), $(item)Linking Books$(), and the $(thing)Book Binder$(). The binder is where an authored Age begins.

The usual loop is simple: gather pages, write a descriptive book, give the Age a name in the binder, and use the book to create the dimension. Stable writing rewards precision. Sparse or contradictory writing invites instability.
